objectives_en: At a supervised manikin station, show help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved adult sequence; record each observed action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Ang training manikin ay adult na hindi tumutugon at hindi…
sections.takeaway_en: Case: A training manikin represents an adult who is unresponsive…

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa supervised manikin, ipakita ang pagtawag, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong adult sequence; itala ang naobserbahan.
sections.takeaway_en: At a supervised manikin station, show help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved adult sequence; record each observed action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.

check.prompt_fil: Sa kasong ito, ano ang unang tugon?
check.prompt_en: In this case, what comes first?

options.fil: Gawin muna ang shortcut kahit walang kumpirmasyon.
options.en: Use the shortcut before confirming the facts.

options.fil: Maghintay muna at huwag ipaalam sa staff.
options.en: Wait without notifying the responsible staff.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag umasa lamang sa pulso kung hindi sanay. Huwag mag-compression sa totoong tao. Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata. 2: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong. 3: Maaaring maantala ang kinakailangang assessment.
check.feedback_en: 1: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not use a pulse check as the only gate for an untrained rescuer, practise compressions on a live person, or treat the old CAB paragraph as certification. 2: Prioritize safety and timely help. 3: Necessary assessment may be delayed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa supervised manikin, ipakita ang pagtawag, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong adult sequence; itala ang naobserbahan.
sections.takeaway_en: At a supervised manikin station, show help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved adult sequence; record each observed action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
sections.takeaway_en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?

options.fil: Magbigay ng diagnosis mula sa kuwento at mangakong sapat na iyon para sa pasyente.
options.en: Diagnose from the story and promise it is enough for the person.

options.fil: Ulitin ang shortcut kahit may panganib at walang kumpirmadong tagubilin.
options.en: Repeat the shortcut despite the risk and without confirmed guidance.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis. 2: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag umasa lamang sa pulso kung hindi sanay. Huwag mag-compression sa totoong tao. Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata. 3: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
check.feedback_en: 1: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis. 2: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not use a pulse check as the only gate for an untrained rescuer, practise compressions on a live person, or treat the old CAB paragraph as certification. 3: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
